ValidationRule.description: For record types: Contract hire, Lease with R&M, Standalone maintenance – do not allow to switch the initiation to closed status if box id field is empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "closed"), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Contract_Hire', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Lease_with_R_M', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Stane_Alone_Service'), ISBLANK(Box_ID__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the box ID
